chapters.reason: The paper introduces Gated DeltaNet, which builds on Mamba2 and DeltaNet, both linear-state models using predetermined algebraic update rules (delta rule) for a matrix-valued hidden state, fitting the linear-state recurrence description.

The gated delta rule and architecture are related to Infini-attention's use of a compressive memory and linear-delta rule for efficient long-context processing, though Gated DeltaNet is a distinct model improving on Mamba2.

While the paper focuses on linear-state recurrence, it mentions hybrid architectures and adaptive memory control, which have conceptual overlap with gradient-state methods, but the core mechanism is not gradient-based optimization.
